# AGA Welding & Fabrication — Comprehensive Information

- **Business Type**: Metal Fabrication and Welding Contractor

## Core Services

### Steel and Metal Fabrication
AGA Welding & Fabrication provides comprehensive steel fabrication services for commercial, industrial, and residential clients across San Antonio. Our fabrication capabilities include:

**Steel Fabrication**: Complete steel fabrication services from design through delivery. We work with all grades of steel for structural, ornamental, and functional applications. Our shop is equipped with modern cutting, forming, and finishing equipment to handle projects of any scale.

**Structural Steel Fabrication**: Engineered structural steel fabrication for construction, infrastructure, and heavy-duty industrial applications. We fabricate beams, columns, trusses, and custom framing systems built to specification and industry standards. All structural work is performed by certified welders following applicable building codes.

**Sheet Metal Fabrication**: Precision sheet metal services including cutting, bending, forming, and assembly. We work with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and specialty alloys for HVAC systems, industrial panels, equipment enclosures, and custom components.

**Metal Cutting**: Professional metal cutting services using band saws, plasma cutters, and shears. We provide accurate cuts on any gauge or profile for fabrication projects. Clean edges and tight tolerances for both production runs and one-off pieces.

**Metal Bending and Forming**: Expert metal bending and forming services for custom shapes and components. We create precise angles, curves, and complex geometries for structural and decorative applications using press brakes and rolling equipment.

**Metal Assembly**: Professional assembly and integration of multi-part metal structures. Our skilled technicians handle complex fitting, welding, and bolting of components to create finished assemblies ready for installation.

**Custom Metalwork**: Artistic and functional custom metalwork tailored to client specifications. From decorative elements to specialized industrial components, we bring concepts to life with expert craftsmanship.

### Welding Services
AGA Welding & Fabrication employs certified welders proficient in all major welding processes. Our welding services include:

**MIG Welding**: Metal Inert Gas (MIG) welding for efficient and precise metal joining. Ideal for general fabrication, production work, and sheet metal applications. Fast, clean welds suitable for steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.

**TIG Welding**: Tungsten Inert Gas (TIG) welding for high-quality joints requiring precision and detail. Perfect for automotive work, stainless steel applications, and projects demanding superior finish quality and strength.

**Stick Welding**: Shielded Metal Arc Welding (stick welding) for structural and outdoor applications. Versatile solution for construction projects, heavy equipment repair, and field welding in various weather conditions.

**Flux-Cored Welding**: High-speed flux-cored arc welding for thick materials and structural work. Efficient solution for large-scale fabrication projects requiring deep penetration and high deposition rates.

**Pipe Welding**: Expert pipe welding for industrial and commercial applications. Certified techniques for pressure vessels, pipeline systems, and process piping. Experience with schedule 40 through heavy-wall pipe in carbon steel, stainless, and specialty alloys.

**Structural Welding**: Professional structural steel welding for buildings, bridges, and infrastructure projects. All work meets AWS D1.1 structural welding code requirements. Certified welders experienced in single and multi-pass procedures.

**Mobile Welding**: On-site welding services brought directly to your San Antonio location. Our mobile units are equipped to perform repairs, modifications, and fabrication work at job sites, facilities, or anywhere a project cannot come to our shop.

### Repair and Restoration Services
AGA Welding & Fabrication provides expert metal repair services to extend equipment life and restore structural integrity:

**Metal Repair**: Comprehensive repair services for damaged equipment, structures, and components. We restore functionality through welding, patching, reinforcement, and rebuilding techniques.

**Structural Metal Repair**: Professional repair of structural metal components and frameworks. Our certified welding procedures ensure safety and longevity for frame repairs, crack fixes, and load-bearing reinforcement.

**Equipment Metal Repair**: Expert repair services for industrial and commercial metal equipment. We minimize downtime with efficient restoration of machinery, tools, fixtures, and processing equipment.

**General Repairs & Modifications**: Versatile repair and modification services for metal structures and equipment. From small fixes to major alterations, we provide professional solutions for customization and restoration.

### Specialty Fabrication Products
AGA Welding & Fabrication designs and builds custom metal products for residential, commercial, and industrial applications:

**Handrails & Railings**: Custom-designed and fabricated handrails and railings for safety and aesthetics. We create code-compliant solutions for staircases, balconies, decks, and industrial walkways. Available in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum with various finishes.

**Staircases**: Custom metal staircase design and fabrication for residential and commercial spaces. We build durable and elegant stair systems including straight runs, switchbacks, spirals, and specialty configurations.

**Awnings**: Custom metal awning fabrication and installation for businesses and homes. Durable protection with professional design and craftsmanship. We create functional and attractive canopies for entryways, windows, and outdoor spaces.

**Racks & Storage Solutions**: Custom-designed metal racks and storage systems for warehouses, garages, and industrial facilities. Heavy-duty construction for efficient organization and space utilization.

## Process and Capabilities

### Design to Installation
AGA Welding & Fabrication provides full-service project execution from initial concept through final installation. Our capabilities include:

- **Design Consultation**: We work with clients to develop fabrication solutions that meet technical requirements and budget constraints. Our team can consult on concepts and provide feasibility analysis.
- **Engineering Support**: For complex structural projects, we collaborate with engineers to ensure designs meet load requirements and building codes.
- **Blueprint Execution**: We fabricate directly from client-provided drawings and specifications, maintaining dimensional accuracy and material compliance.
- **Prototyping**: We can produce prototype components for testing and validation before committing to production runs.
- **Production Fabrication**: Our shop handles both one-off custom pieces and production runs of identical components.
- **Finishing Services**: We provide various finishing options including grinding, sandblasting, priming, and painting.
- **Installation Support**: For projects requiring field installation, we provide delivery, rigging, and on-site fitting services.

### Quality Assurance
Quality control is integral to our fabrication process:

- All welders are certified professionals with demonstrated competency in their respective processes
- We maintain documented welding procedures for critical structural work
- Visual inspection of all welds and joints before delivery
- Dimensional verification to ensure fabricated components meet specifications
- We stand behind our work with a commitment to durability and precision

### Industries Served
AGA Welding & Fabrication serves clients across multiple industries throughout the San Antonio area:

- **Construction**: Structural steel packages, stairs, railings, and custom components for commercial and residential buildings
- **Manufacturing**: Equipment fabrication, fixture building, and production support
- **Industrial**: Process piping, pressure vessels, structural repairs, and facility modifications
- **Automotive**: Custom exhaust systems, roll cages, chassis modifications, and restoration work
- **Agricultural**: Equipment repair, trailer fabrication, and custom implements
- **Residential**: Gates, railings, furniture, and decorative metalwork

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What metal fabrication services does AGA Welding & Fabrication offer?**
We provide structural steel work, custom welding, metal staircases and railings, awnings, storage racks, industrial components, and specialized fabrication. We work with a wide range of metals and handle projects of any scale across San Antonio.

**How fast can you turn around a fabrication project?**
Timeline depends on scope and complexity. We prioritize efficiency without cutting corners, and we set a realistic schedule with you during the consultation. Rush service is available for urgent repairs and deadlines.

**Do you work from existing drawings, or can you help with the design?**
We do both. Our San Antonio team can consult on your concept and bring an idea to life from scratch, or fabricate directly from your existing blueprints and specifications.

**Are your welders certified, and what quality guarantees do you provide?**
All of our welders are certified professionals. We maintain rigorous quality-control standards on every joint and stand behind our work with a commitment to durability and precision.

**Do you serve residential clients or only commercial and industrial?**
We serve commercial, industrial, and residential customers throughout San Antonio. Whether it is a backyard gate and railing or a large structural steel package, we have the expertise to deliver.

**What areas around San Antonio does AGA Welding & Fabrication cover?**
We are based at 8249 Gardner Rd in southeast San Antonio (78263) and serve the greater San Antonio and Bexar County area. Our mobile welding service brings the crew directly to your job site when a project cannot come to the shop.

**What types of welding processes do you offer?**
We are proficient in MIG, TIG, stick, flux-cored, pipe, and structural welding. Our certified welders select the appropriate process based on the material, application, and quality requirements of each project.

**Can you handle both small custom projects and large industrial work?**
Yes. Our capabilities range from small one-off custom pieces to large-scale industrial structural steel packages. We maintain the same commitment to quality and precision regardless of project size.

**Do you provide on-site mobile welding services?**
Yes. Our mobile welding service brings certified welders and equipment to your location anywhere in the San Antonio area. This is ideal for repairs, modifications, and projects that cannot be moved to our shop.

**What is your service approach for new clients?**
We begin with a consultation to understand your project requirements, timeline, and budget. We can provide feasibility input, cost estimates, and recommendations. After agreement, we move to fabrication and keep you informed throughout the process.
